approach: N64Recomp static recompilation built from the game's decompilation, on N64ModernRuntime with RT64 rendering
notes: Native Windows, Linux and Android (arm64, Vulkan) builds. Widescreen, higher internal resolutions, analog camera, autosave, save import, on-screen touch controls and an Adreno GPU driver loader on Android. Bring your own USA cartridge; no game data ships in any build.
